text:
Nina (Partnerships): quick sync request 10m 9am PT tomorrow with Vertex Cloud team. They want our marketplace tile to include a "telemetry certified" badge showing Datadog+OTel trace/metric compatibility for private deployments. Can we validate requirements?

Omar (Eng-ML): compatibility checklist: 1) OTLP ingest (gRPC/http) 2) span attribute mapping for model_id/variant 3) stable sampling header so we can reconstruct p95 per model.

Diego (Obs Eng): add: dashboard import JSON with the following panels: request rate, p95 latency by model, kv-cache hit ratio, GPU utilization. We'll need a standard span naming convention: redwood.inference.request and attributes: model.name, model.version, seq_len.

Keiko (Marketplace): marketplace listing requires an automated smoke test that runs on partner's staging account and produces a pass/fail JSON. Can we produce a small test harness that hits a demo endpoint and verifies spans appear in Datadog (or in offline upload for airgap)?

Diego (Obs Eng): for air-gapped customers we'll support offline bundle verification: otelcol -> file exporter -> verify script that checks manifest and span mappings. Example verification output minimal schema: {"status":"ok","spans_seen":123,"models": ["redwood-v1"]} (we'll ship as JSON).

Omar (Eng-ML): small otelcol snippet for span attributes (demo):
```yaml
processors:
  attributes:
    actions:
      - key: model.name
        action: insert
        value: "redwood-v1"
service:
  pipelines:
    traces:
      receivers: [otlp]
```

Datadog Bot: Reference: Datadog trace ingestion + offline docs https://docs.datadoghq.com/api/latest/traces/ (shared)

Keiko (Marketplace): action items: @Diego prepare dashboard JSON + verification script, @Omar add model attribute enrichment to our runtime, @Nina coordinate Vertex staging slot. I'll draft a Marketplace checklist and the certification copy.

Nina (Partnerships): perfect. keep thread short; we'll capture the formal checklist in the marketplace repo after the smoke test. :sparkles:
